title: Audit Console through computer use and design a focused multi-screen workspace
description:
Real owner feedback: excessive scrolling, everything on one page feels like a generic Bootstrap layout. Clean, clear and functional first. Session Manager must assign existing owner-console web UI specialist. Inspect actual live installed Console http://127.0.0.1:4174/console with computer use, not source-only review. Cover every navigation area, nested operational panels and action flows; read-only on live, explore writes only in isolated demo. Actually view screenshot evidence desktop and mobile, keyboard navigation, navigation position/history, refresh/draft retention, density, scrolling and empty/failure/loading states. Document visited screens and concrete issues with screenshot references. Propose focused routes/views, compact overview, contextual drilldowns and per-agent conversations, conditional pipelines, accessible navigation and honest runtime/approval status. Retain dark mode/TORCH mark. Audit and proposal only; do not rewrite UI before review. Use applicable frontend/browser skills and disclose computer-use capability blockers instead of claiming completion.

With a fresh browser session/tab, viewport set before navigation to 351x760 at DPR 0.9, DOM confirmed exactly 390x844 CSS and visible Overview content.
